correctness.rationale: Complementing all four frequency bits in one column does not change a character on a column of X with exactly two ones. Thus only three relative bits per column matter: eight types, and column permutations reduce the 2^24 n=3 frequencies to 1716 histograms, each with exact multiplicity 2^(2n)(2n)!/prod(c_v!). Selecting the six possible row pairs per column gives coefficient [z_1^n...z_4^n]prod_v P_v(z)^c_v. Dynamic programming storing three row counts (fourth determined by 2t) has O(n^3) states, 2n steps and six transitions, O(n^4) per histogram, O(n^11) overall; coefficients have O(n) bit length. An independently written integer DP enumerated all 1716 n=3 type histograms, reproduced all 29 signed levels and multiplicities, 8388608 zeros and Parseval 2^24*1860. Inspection of the pinned verify_eulerian_k46.py and its source CSV blob confirms it recomputes every orbit coefficient and does 256 auxiliary direct signed sums, rather than claiming sampled frequencies exhaustive. Exactly half frequencies are odd weight and vanish by complement symmetry; the exact census shows none of the even-weight ones vanish, giving range equal to complement-even functions and norm-one projection. Minimum nonzero 4 and maximum1860 give condition465.

value.rationale: This is the first non-square four-row Eulerian-orientation grid K_{4,6}, where the signed spectral census answers exactly how much information convolution loses and its optimal L² recovery stability. Eight-type compression gives an all-width polynomial-time exact method replacing 2^(8n) direct characters. The 29-level spectrum, half-rank and sharp gap are independently useful invariants of a natural balanced-table family, not an arbitrary tiny slice.

final_claim: For balanced binary 4x2n matrices with row sums n and column sums2, all unnormalized Walsh coefficients admit an eight-column-type coefficient formula and complete signed-spectrum enumeration in O(n^11) exact arithmetic operations; in 4x6, the full 29-level spectrum has 8388608 zero frequencies, minimum nonzero magnitude4 and max1860, so convolution rank 2^23 and recoverable-space condition number465.
limitations: The 29-level finite spectrum and half-rank proof apply specifically at 4x6; no assertion that all larger widths have half-rank or min nonzero4. The 1716-orbit computation is exhaustive because of the proved multiplicity partition, not because 256 random direct tests are exhaustive.
residual_risks: A hidden multivariate Krawtchouk or signed contingency-table distribution could give equivalent eight-type formulas; full Barvinok and Beluhov texts not inspected. The O(n^11) bound counts arithmetic operations, not bit complexity; no assertion of all-width gap nonvanishing.
